description: TIMED texture of USER-WRITTEN MOTIFS: written melodic shapes (as in texture motifs) fired at the hits of a COMPOSED timing cell (as in texture timed). The notedata file carries line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch, then the TIMING '#N' block (rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur' - the rhythmic cell, restated every last-onset + skip seconds), then ONE OR MORE further '#N' blocks = the motif shapes ('Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' if the motif blocks are missing - ornate-family rule, extras legal). Pinned to submode 5 (NONE - free pitch; the 'tmotifsin' sibling is the every-note-on-harmonic-field variant, modes 1-4 only, dropped: same-length different-sample render at the same seed, and NOTE its usage banner omits outdur/skiptime although the binary REQUIRES them - banner bug pinned in the tranche-18 findings). Each motif statement starts at a random pitch between minpitch/maxpitch; multlo/multhi (0.01-100, family-enforced) scale statement pacing. Genuinely stochastic with a WORKING -r seed (-r5 twice 1.2 s apart byte-identical; -r9 differs). Duration honesty: outdur 5 -> 6.16 (+23%), outdur 8 -> 9.31 (+16%). Breakpoints: outdur/gpspace/contour/seed refuse (parameters 1/14/17/30 verbatim); ALL 11 other numeric positionals plus -a/-p/-s accept (full sweep; skip additionally VERIFIED against both scalar endpoints at seed 5). Mono input only; output always STEREO; flag order enforced (family).
musical_use: Composed rhythm AND composed melody, textured: your cell says WHEN, your motif blocks say WHAT SHAPE, the engine re-dices register, level and pacing per statement. This is the tightest-composed member of the texture family short of writing a score - use it for riff-based structures (a bass cell firing arpeggio shapes), hocketing figures locked to a groove, or litany-like repetitions whose transposition wanders. Multiple motif blocks build a rotating vocabulary over one rhythm. multlo/multhi below 1 snap motifs into the cell's gaps; above 1 lets statements overlap the next hit for chained legato swarms. Breakpoint skip to accelerate the groove; breakpoint minpitch/maxpitch to sweep the register across the piece. Siblings: timed (single events), tgrouped (random bursts), motifs (same shapes, stochastic placement). Always seed to pin a take.

notedata.description: REQUIRED text file (write_data_file()): line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch; then the TIMING '#N' block (rhythmic cell); then one or more MOTIF '#N' blocks (rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur'). Missing motif blocks: 'Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

outdur.description: Requested (minimum) duration; ran +23% (outdur 5) to +16% (outdur 8) over on the probe. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1').

skip.description: Gap between statements of the timing cell (period = last cell onset + skip, timed-family rule). Breakpoint-capable and VERIFIED: a 0.8->2.0 brk at seed 5 differs from both scalar-endpoint renders. Keep positive.

sndfirst.description: First sound from the input list (must be 1 here). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

sndlast.description: Last sound from the input list (must be 1 here). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

minpitch.description: Minimum start pitch of motif statements (MIDI). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

maxpitch.description: Maximum start pitch of motif statements (MIDI). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

phgrid.description: Timegrid in ms WITHIN motifs (0 = none). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

gpspace.description: Spatialisation of motif-groups 0-5 (family values). Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 14').

gpsprange.description: Spatial range of motif-groups 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

amprise.description: Amplitude change within motifs 0-127 (default 0). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

contour.description: Amplitude contour of groups 0-6. Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 17').

multlo.description: Minimum multiplier of each motif statement's total duration (family-enforced 0.01-100). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

multhi.description: Maximum motif-duration multiplier (>= multlo). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

atten.description: Overall attenuation multiplier (family range). Breakpoint accepted. Flag order enforced: -a -p -s -r then switches.

position.description: Centre of the stereo image 0-1 (family-enforced). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

spread.description: Spatial spread of texture events 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

seed.description: Random seed - WORKING (-r5 pair byte-identical; -r9 differs). 0/omission = clock. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 30').

whole.description: Play the whole input per event (verified: changes render).

samedur.description: Motif notes all take the same duration (verified: changes render).

instrvary.description: Motifs not confined to a fixed instrument - multi-input only (verified byte-identical no-op on this single-input entry).

examples.description: A rising three-note motif fired on a two-hit cell, register roaming an octave.

known_issues: Duration honesty (set_by outdur): +23% at outdur 5, +16% at outdur 8 on the 0.5 s-ping probe; duration row pinned at outdur 8, tol 0.3, seed 5.

Notedata block order is TIMING CELL FIRST, then motif block(s) (source texprepro.c: timeset -> phrases); missing motif blocks refuse 'Insufficient motifs in notedata file.'; extra motif blocks legal (vocabulary).

SIBLING DROPS: tmotifsin (every-note-on-field variant, modes 1-4 only) renders same-length different-sample at the same seed and its usage banner OMITS outdur/skiptime although the binary requires them ('Insufficient cmdline parameters.' without; runs with) - banner bug pinned in the tranche-18 findings; execute()-only.

Breakpoint surface: outdur/gpspace/contour/seed refuse (parameters 1/14/17/30 verbatim); all 11 other numeric positionals plus -a/-p/-s accept (full sweep; skip verified against both endpoints at seed 5).
Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO; flag order enforced; working -r seed. -i single-input no-op (verified).
